title: Toxicity in the Decentralized Web and the Potential for Model Sharing
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring toxicity and hate speech in decentralized social networks and proposing a model-sharing framework (ModPair). While it addresses harmful behavior and includes a brief section on fairness and bias within the model-sharing process, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal ethical/moral systems (e.g., utilitarianism or deontology).
